instruction: A giant boombox as a puffed vinyl pool toy, all edges rounded into fat tubular seams with welded ribbing across the front. Two big circular speakers are stitched-in dark grey discs with printed concentric rings, and a bulging cassette door, chunky puffy buttons, and a limp inflated handle sit on top. The glossy plastic surface shows bright highlights, a small valve nub, and slight sag where it isn't fully firm.
